title: A Primer in Post-Training Reasoning Data: What We Know About How It Works
authors_zh: Yaoming Li, Guangxiang Zhao, Qilong Shi, Lin Sun, Xiangzheng Zhang, Tong Yang
best_for_zh: 适合判断应收集什么推理数据、如何验证，以及哪些规模结论能迁移到自身场景的研究人员。
one_line: This primer organizes more than 150 studies into a practical map of reasoning-data objects, utility signals, construction choices, and scaling limits.
这篇 primer 把 150 多项研究整理为推理数据对象、效用信号、构造选择和规模边界的实用地图。
why: It prevents data recipes from being compared without their verifier, base model, trajectory, scale, and lineage context.
inclusion_reason: The primer supplies a decision framework for identifying, constructing, evaluating, and scaling post-training reasoning-data objects.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Post-training reasoning-data papers often report gains without a shared language for the supervised object, its verifier, the model for which it is difficult, or how records were reused. As a result, apparently conflicting claims may describe different prompts, traces, rewards, training stages, or scale regimes rather than a real scientific disagreement.

This primer synthesizes more than 150 public studies and system reports around four practical questions: what reasoning data is, what makes it useful, how it is constructed, and how it scales. It turns scattered results into a decision framework that keeps data, model, verifier, trajectory, and lineage context attached to each claim.

L4 facts: Primary source arXiv:2606.02113 (2026); status: arXiv preprint; decision boundary: accept a claim only within its documented data and evidence contract; evaluation surface: source study, data object, construction path, utility signal, and caveat; collection note: directly defines the post-training reasoning-data field.

后训练推理数据论文常常报告性能提升，却没有统一说明监督对象、verifier、数据对哪种模型有难度，以及记录如何被重复使用。因此，看似冲突的结论可能只是在讨论不同提示、轨迹、奖励、训练阶段或规模区间，而不是真正的科学分歧。

这篇 primer 围绕四个实用问题综合 150 多项公开研究和系统报告：推理数据是什么，什么使其有用，如何构造，以及如何扩展规模。它把分散结果整理为决策框架，并让每项结论始终带着数据、模型、verifier、轨迹和血缘背景。

L4 事实：主来源为 arXiv:2606.02113（2026 年）；状态为 arXiv 预印本；判定边界为只在文档明确的数据与证据契约内接受结论；评估表面包括来源研究、数据对象、构造路径、效用信号和限制；收录理由是它直接定义后训练推理数据领域。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The primer's main contribution is a relational view of data quality. Correctness is relative to a verifier, difficulty to a base model, trace value to a trajectory and training objective, and coverage to source lineage. Construction is then decomposed into prompt source, trace author, search or environment substrate, feedback contract, and selection policy, making recipes comparable without erasing their boundaries.

Google Scholar citations: 1（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=A+Primer+in+Post-Training+Reasoning+Data%3A+What+We+Know+About+How+It+Works&author=Yaoming+Li&hl=en）

Open dataset: no new dataset. - Companion resource: Awesome-LLM-Reasoning-Data at https://github.com/RenBing-Sumeru/Awesome-LLM-Reasoning-Data - Form: an MIT-licensed literature atlas and paper-card project, not a newly collected training corpus. - Scale: the paper synthesizes more than 150 studies and system reports; this is literature coverage, not a number of data records. - Intended use: paper discovery, evidence tracing, data-recipe comparison, and release-audit design. - Access boundary: reuse the companion repository under its license and consult each primary source for dataset terms.

这篇 primer 的主要贡献是对数据质量采用关系式理解。正确性取决于 verifier，难度取决于 base model，轨迹价值取决于具体 trajectory 和训练目标，覆盖度则取决于来源血缘。随后，它把构造流程拆成提示来源、轨迹作者、搜索或环境支架、反馈契约和筛选策略，从而在不抹去边界的情况下比较不同配方。

Google Scholar 引用数：1（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=A+Primer+in+Post-Training+Reasoning+Data%3A+What+We+Know+About+How+It+Works&author=Yaoming+Li&hl=en）

开源数据：没有新的数据集。 - 配套资源：Awesome-LLM-Reasoning-Data，地址为 https://github.com/RenBing-Sumeru/Awesome-LLM-Reasoning-Data - 形式：采用 MIT 许可的文献地图和 paper-card 项目，不是新收集的训练语料。 - 规模：论文综合 150 多项研究和系统报告；这是文献覆盖量，不是数据记录数。 - 用途：论文发现、证据追踪、数据配方比较和发布审计设计。 - 访问边界：配套仓库按其许可复用，各数据集条款仍需查阅对应主来源。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define the data object. Input: a reported post-training gain. Operation: identify whether the supervised record is a prompt-answer pair, demonstration, trajectory, environment interaction, preference, reward, or audit record. Output: a concrete record schema. Check: do not compare papers whose basic objects differ without stating the mismatch.
  2. Recover the feedback contract. Input: the data object and training setup. Operation: classify feedback as programmatic, environmental, or judgment-required and record the terminal predicate. Output: an explicit correctness or utility boundary. Check: note false positives, false negatives, and verifier version.
  3. Trace construction. Input: the retained object. Operation: record prompt source, trace author, search substrate, self-play anchor, verifier or reward, and filters. Output: a reproducible lineage chain. Check: separate source data from generated traces and later selections.
  4. Interpret utility relationally. Input: quality, difficulty, coverage, and downstream results. Operation: attach each measurement to its verifier, base model, trajectory distribution, and source lineage. Output: bounded evidence about usefulness. Check: avoid treating one model's difficulty or one judge's correctness as universal.
  5. Analyze scaling. Input: record count, reuse, rollout budget, and training curves. Operation: distinguish higher performance ceiling from better sample efficiency, track unique data versus repeated exposure, and record test-time-compute topology. Output: a scaling decision. Check: preserve model and verifier versions.
  6. Produce an audit-ready comparison. Input: the previous records. Operation: compare recipes by object, construction, feedback, utility, and scale. Output: a decision table or release checklist. Check: follow every consequential claim back to its primary source.

Reproducibility: this is a question-driven synthesis, not a formal meta-analysis. Reuse requires opening the cited primary papers, recording their exact model, data, verifier, and budget, and updating the companion atlas as releases change.

1. 定义数据对象。 输入：一项后训练收益报告。操作：判断监督记录是提示-答案对、示范、轨迹、环境交互、偏好、奖励，还是审计记录。输出：具体的记录 schema。检查：若两篇论文的基本对象不同，不能在不说明差异的情况下直接比较。
  2. 恢复反馈契约。 输入：数据对象和训练设置。操作：把反馈归为程序式、环境式或需要判断，并记录终止条件。输出：明确的正确性或效用边界。检查：注明误报、漏报和 verifier 版本。
  3. 追踪构造流程。 输入：保留的数据对象。操作：记录提示来源、轨迹作者、搜索支架、自博弈锚点、verifier 或奖励以及过滤器。输出：可复现的血缘链。检查：区分来源数据、生成轨迹和后续筛选。
  4. 按关系解释效用。 输入：质量、难度、覆盖度和下游结果。操作：把每个测量值绑定到对应 verifier、base model、轨迹分布和来源血缘。输出：有边界的效用证据。检查：不能把某个模型的难度或某个 judge 的正确性视为普遍结论。
  5. 分析规模扩展。 输入：记录数、复用次数、rollout 预算和训练曲线。操作：区分更高性能上限与更高样本效率，追踪独立数据与重复暴露，并记录 test-time compute 的结构。输出：规模决策。检查：保留模型和 verifier 版本。
  6. 形成可审计比较。 输入：前述记录。操作：按对象、构造、反馈、效用和规模比较配方。输出：决策表或发布清单。检查：每项重要结论都应回到对应主来源。

复现要求：这是一项问题驱动的综合，而不是正式 meta-analysis。复用时必须打开引用的主论文，记录其具体模型、数据、verifier 和预算，并随着版本变化更新配套地图。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Breadth and organization of evidence. This paper does not claim a new controlled experiment. Its evidence is a synthesis of more than 150 public studies and system reports, routed through four questions about object, utility, construction, and scaling. The useful check is whether a conclusion is supported by identifiable primary sources with the same model, verifier, and budget context. Boundary: literature count is not effect-size aggregation, and source coverage is not guaranteed exhaustive.

Cross-study consistency. The framework explains recurring findings without forcing one universal quality score: correctness changes with the verifier, difficulty with the learner, trace value with the trajectory distribution, and scaling with unique-data reuse and compute topology. This makes apparently conflicting results testable as configuration differences. Boundary: the primer summarizes reported evidence and does not reproduce the cited experiments.

证据广度与组织。 本文没有声称进行新的受控实验。其证据来自 150 多项公开研究和系统报告，并按照对象、效用、构造和规模四个问题组织。关键检查是：一项结论能否追溯到可识别的主来源，而且模型、verifier 和预算背景一致。边界：文献数量不等于 effect size 汇总，也不能保证来源覆盖完整。

跨研究一致性。 该框架无需假设一个通用质量分数，也能解释反复出现的结果：正确性随 verifier 变化，难度随 learner 变化，轨迹价值随 trajectory 分布变化，规模效果随独立数据复用和算力结构变化。这使看似冲突的结果可以被检验为配置差异。边界：primer 只综合已报告证据，没有复现所引用实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing surveys often catalog datasets, training algorithms, or benchmarks separately. This primer centers the reasoning-data record and connects its source, generator, feedback contract, downstream utility, reuse, and scaling behavior in one decision framework. Its novelty is the cross-layer evidence map and relative definitions of quality, not a new optimizer, verifier, or dataset.
以往综述通常分别罗列数据集、训练算法或 benchmark。这篇 primer 以推理数据记录为中心，在同一决策框架中连接来源、生成器、反馈契约、下游效用、复用和规模行为。新意是跨层证据地图和对质量的关系式定义，而不是新的 optimizer、verifier 或数据集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Public-evidence bias. The synthesis sees published papers and system reports, not private data pipelines or negative industrial results. Treat coverage as a map of visible evidence.
  • Not a formal meta-analysis. Study selection is question-driven and heterogeneous results are not combined into effect sizes. Return to primary sources for quantitative decisions.
  • Comparability remains limited. Models, verifiers, data mixtures, budgets, and benchmarks vary widely. Reconstruct these settings before transferring a claim.

• 公开证据偏差。 综合范围只包括已发表论文和系统报告，看不到私有数据流程或工业界的负面结果。因此，覆盖范围应被视为可见证据地图。
  • 不是正式 meta-analysis。 研究选择由问题驱动，异质结果没有汇总成 effect size。做定量决策时必须回到主来源。
  • 可比性仍然有限。 模型、verifier、数据混合、预算和 benchmark 差异很大。迁移一项结论前应重建这些设置。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use the primer before collecting or purchasing reasoning data. Describe the target record, available verifier, base model, trace source, search substrate, reuse plan, and evaluation budget; then use the atlas to locate recipes with matching contracts and open their primary evidence. Success means the chosen pipeline has explicit lineage, terminal predicates, and transfer checks. Do not use the primer as proof that one listed recipe will reproduce another paper's gain.
在收集或购买推理数据前，可以使用这篇 primer。先描述目标记录、可用 verifier、base model、轨迹来源、搜索支架、复用计划和评测预算，再用地图寻找契约相近的配方，并打开对应主证据。成功标准是所选流程具有明确血缘、终止条件和迁移检查。不能把 primer 当作某个列出配方必然复现他人收益的证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Always name the supervised object before discussing reasoning-data quality.
  2. Correctness, difficulty, trace utility, and coverage are relative to verifier, model, trajectory, and lineage.
  3. Construction should record prompt source, trace author, search substrate, feedback contract, and selection.
  4. Scaling claims must separate unique records, repeated exposure, rollout budget, and performance ceiling.
  5. Use the primer to route decisions, then verify every consequential claim in its primary source.

1. 讨论推理数据质量前，必须先说明监督对象。
  2. 正确性、难度、轨迹效用和覆盖度分别取决于 verifier、模型、trajectory 和血缘。
  3. 构造记录应包含提示来源、轨迹作者、搜索支架、反馈契约和筛选过程。
  4. 规模结论必须区分独立记录、重复暴露、rollout 预算和性能上限。
  5. 用 primer 为决策定位，再到主来源核验每项重要结论。
